files.name: motion-prompt-108.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Panning shot" (流し撮り), one of the names in "Photo looks, lighting & styles".
Motion Prompt #108

What it is: Follow a moving subject so only the background streaks
What the sample shows: The camera follows the moving car: the car stays sharp in the middle of the frame while only the buildings, trees and lamps behind it streak sideways.
Spec:
- Street corner: buildings, trees and lamps behind a road at y 132–162 (no large person in front)
- Car: without the effect it drives from x −80 to 620 in 5 s; with it, it stays at x 270 ±10 px
- Streak: the background is drawn 12 times spread over 46 px sideways and averaged (spread 0 → 46 px)
- Wheels: a spoke line turns 12 times per 5 s
- Top-right shutter speed 1/1000 → 1/15
- Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
When to use it: To show the speed of a car, bike or runner in a still photo.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/108.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/photo.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
